messages:
alex: Heads-up — Deploybot queued a rollforward/unpin of runtime v3.2 for 2026-11-03 02:00 UTC. I flagged potential SDK 2.10 compatibility gaps with quant kernels. Need a quick ops + QE checklist before we open the canary window.

deploybot: Automated note: action=rollforward, target=runtime:v3.2, requested_by=alex, schedule=2026-11-03T02:00:00Z. Canary=10%, window=2h. /deploybot plan-id=rbf-3344.

maria: @alex thanks — can you paste the exact deploybot command so infra can pre-warm? :eyes:

alex: Sure — copying the command we used in the preflight run:

```
/deploybot rollforward runtime=v3.2 --canary=10% --window=2h --fallback=runtime=v3.1
```

sam: Quick note: the SDK 2.10 client lib with the new KV-cache changes is still rolling to a subset of customers (region=eu-west). If a canary request hits a host serving quant-v4b we saw token misordering in stage yesterday. Recommend routing 10% canary to hosts without quant-v4b for first 30m.

jen: +1. Also let's add an automatic fallback rule to route errors >0.5% to runtime=v3.1 and trigger an immediate pause. We should document that in the runbook.

liz (QE): I can run the regression set (generation + long-seq + embeddings) against v3.2 on a staging cluster now. ETA ~45m. I will post the failing prompt IDs.

ops-bot: Telemetry alert subscription created: channel=#eng-releases (ops-bot). Traces to watch: token-reorder, kv-cache-miss, latency-p99. Thresholds set: error-rate>0.5%, p99>400ms.

maria: Who owns release notes/outage comms for this? We should include the fallback behavior and SDK compatibility caveats.

alex: I'll draft a short blurb for release-notes and the internal changelog. Will mention: "If you use SDK<2.10, no action required; SDK=2.10 clients may see degraded behavior with quant-v4b kernels — we route automatically to compatible runtime variants."

sam: Ops ask: can we add a temporary pinlist exception for a small model group (embedding-small) to keep it on v3.1 until SDK rollout hits 100%? Otherwise customers using embedding-small will see different latency profiles.

deploybot: Pinlist update proposal: add exception 'embedding-small' -> pinned_runtime=v3.1 for window=4d. Approve with `/deploybot apply-pin-exception rbf-3344 --target=embedding-small --runtime=v3.1 --duration=96h`

jen: Approving exception for embedding-small. Also add a note to the runbook: how to revoke the exception.

liz (QE): Running initial regressions now. Posting failures if any. If everything green, we can start canary at 10% and keep routing rule for first 30m.

ops-bot: Capacity note: regional pool eu-west has lower spare capacity tonight (predicted 65% utilization). Recommend delaying heavier canary ramps in that region until 02:30Z.

alex: OK — plan adjusted: global 10% canary except eu-west at 0% for first 30m. Then evaluate telemetry and increase to 10% if green. I will attach the runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/unpin-rollforward-v3.2

maria: I've updated the internal changelog entry and added the SDK compatibility warning. Linking to the customer-facing release note draft in #product-release-drafts.

liz (QE): Regression finished: generation+embed passes, long-seq test shows two prompts with token shuffle on quant-v4b hosts (IDs: prompt_9987, prompt_10011). I recommend holding full rollout until we confirm kernel fallback works.

sam: Thanks liz — that's the behavior we saw in stage. We should keep the kv-cache compatibility shim enabled for v3.2 for the first 4 hours. That reduces throughput but avoids misorders.

jen: Agreed. Enable shim for first 4h. Also set abort condition: if token-reorder count > 5 per minute OR error-rate>0.5% for 10m -> automatic rollback to v3.1.

deploybot: Action update: shim=kv-cache-compat:enabled(duration=4h), abort-rules applied. Canary schedule updated: eu-west excluded for first 30m. See plan rbf-3344.

alex: Final checklist before 02:00Z: 1) QE ok (liz) 2) Pin exception applied (jen) 3) Runbook linked (alex) 4) Telemetry thresholds active (ops-bot) 5) SDK note in changelog (maria). If all thumbs-up we start.

maria: 👍 I confirm SDK note posted.

sam: 👍 exception is in place.

liz (QE): 👍 QE green except the two long-seq promp IDs — shim in place should mitigate.

jen: 👍 runbook updated with rollback steps.

ops-bot: Monitoring channel created; pager escalation only if abort triggers.

alex: Launching per plan. Will post updates in-thread and escalate if we hit abort. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
